description: This Java source file defines the Spring MVC Controller 'CustomShippingMethodsController', which manages custom shipping methods, regions, and pricing for an e-commerce platform's admin panel. The controller provides endpoints for CRUD operations, validation, and configuration of weight-based shipping regions and prices.

classes.name: CustomShippingMethodsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling custom weight-based shipping method administration, including CRUD operations, validation, and configuration.

methods.name: getWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the weight-based shipping method configuration page.

methods.name: addCustomRegion
methods.description: Adds a new custom shipping region to the configuration.

methods.name: addCountryToCustomRegion
methods.description: Associates a country with a specific custom shipping region.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Saves the weight-based shipping configuration settings.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country from a custom shipping region.

methods.name: deletePrice
methods.description: Removes a price rule based on maximum weight within a region.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Deletes the entire weight-based shipping method configuration.

methods.name: checkRegionCode
methods.description: Checks if a region code already exists to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: pageCustomShipping
methods.description: Provides paginated list of custom shipping regions for a store.

methods.name: pageCustomShippingDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed weight-based quote items for a specific region.

methods.name: editCustomShipping
methods.description: Loads existing custom region data for editing.

methods.name: populateModel
methods.description: Sets up model attributes needed for shipping configuration pages.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the navigation menu context for the admin UI.
